mentions.name: macOS-native Bible search app
mentions.description: A fast, native macOS Bible search app that lays out all 31k verses in a single scrollable window in under 10ms and filters search results with each keystroke in under 6ms. It supports deep search syntax (ranges, quoting), lets users click an English word to search for verses containing the Greek, Hebrew, or Aramaic word it translates, matches Old Testament verses via the Septuagint for a given Greek word, and includes built-in Greek and Hebrew lexicons that display entries for each original-language term.
mentions.source_excerpt: A fast macOS-native Bible search app
mentions.author: TimTheTinker
